service_boundary: Represents Qianfan ModelBuilder, not the ERNIE model family, consumer chat products, Qianfan AppBuilder, or generic Baidu AI APIs.
regional_controls: International and mainland-China service paths and terms differ; endpoint and deployment availability must be verified for the selected Baidu Cloud region.
retention_controls: The Qianfan user agreement and applicable Baidu Cloud policies govern platform data; model, training, and deployed-service paths have distinct storage behavior.
routing: The platform exposes multiple models and deployment options but is not documented here as an automatic price- or latency-based upstream router.
customization: Qianfan supports data management, training, tuning, model management, and cloud deployment of inference services.
strengths: Combines Baidu's first-party models with third-party and open-model services.
Provides an end-to-end enterprise model development and serving path.
tradeoffs: International and mainland service boundaries differ.
Most detailed operational documentation is Chinese-language and feature-specific.
